settings.hero_subtitle: Discover the world of William Wood for trade professionals.
settings.intro_body: Whether you're an interior designer, architect, hotelier, or a private client with a project in mind, our trade programme offers preferential pricing, dedicated support and priority access to our full collection of mirrors and furniture handcrafted in Britain.
settings.split_body: Each piece is designed in-house and handmade to order in our British workshop. Sustainable materials, timeless proportions, and refined finishes — pieces made to grace a home for generations.
settings.audience_body: Our trade programme is open to accredited professionals working on residential, commercial or hospitality projects.
settings.cta_body: Complete a short application and one of our advisors will be in touch within 48 hours.

settings.title: Trade Discount

settings.title: Dedicated Support
settings.body: A personal account manager to guide you and your clients through every project.

settings.title: Sample Service
settings.body: Access finishes, materials and swatches to plan your projects with confidence.

settings.title: Bespoke Commissions
